newsitem.title: USA: PHLX plans SangStat, Synovus options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX plans SangStat, Synovus options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it will list options on SangStat Medical Corp and Synovus Financial Corp shares on April 1.

The SangStat options will have initial strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with expirations in April, May, July and October. Position limits are 7,500 contracts and Gateway Partners will be the specialist unit.
Synovus options will have strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with expirations in April, May, August and November. Position limits are 4,500 and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit.
